obligations.note: The new code in OutboundClient.url_for rewrites the statement-delivery base URL from https:// to http:// for any path starting with /archive/. That outbound endpoint therefore runs over plaintext HTTP. The passing test_integrations_use_tls only checks the declared base URLs, not the URLs actually built.

The INTEGRATIONS list is unchanged and its entries (core-banking, sanctions-screening, statement-delivery) match controls/payments/asset-inventory.json. Each inventory entry has an owner and a data classification, and the archive path uses the same host.
The register has no exception for ENC-2 on component payments.integrations. Nothing authorises the TLS downgrade.
Ticket CHG-24482 is standard and was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-12, before the change opened. Its components (payments.integrations) cover the only touched file.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver who is not the author Mara Costa under any of her addresses, gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit aa4e9b6e, and that is the change's only commit.

run.json reports success on the head commit, but the attached JUnit report does not match that run. It was produced on hostname dev-laptop-7.local, not ci-runner-08, and is timestamped 2026-10-23, after the 2026-10-16 review time. Its provenance as the change's CI evidence cannot be established.
integrations.py is in the security-sensitive component payments.integrations. Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, approved the head commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers integrations.py, so no prior evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: The change makes statement-delivery archive requests use http:// instead of https://. This directly violates ENC-2 (every outbound integration uses TLS), and no exception in the register authorises it. The ticket, independent code review and security review are in order. However, the CI JUnit report appears to come from a developer machine and is dated after the review time, so testing evidence is not established. The ENC-2 violation alone requires rejection.
